text.en: Blood and protein in the urine during glomerulonephritis mean the kidney is producing these substances abnormally -- in reality, blood and protein appearing in the urine reflect damage to the glomerular filtration barrier's normal size-selectivity, letting red blood cells and proteins cross into the filtrate that a healthy, intact barrier would never have allowed through in the first place; the kidney isn't producing these substances, it's failing to keep them out of the urine.
text.et: Veri ja valk uriinis glomerulonefriidi ajal tähendavad, et neer toodab neid aineid ebanormaalselt -- tegelikult peegeldab veri ja valk uriinis kahjustust glomerulaarse filtratsioonibarjääri normaalsele suurusselektiivsusele, lubades punaseid vereliblesid ja valke sattuda filtraati, mida terve, terviklik barjäär ei oleks kunagi lasknud algselt läbi; neer ei tooda neid aineid, see ei suuda neid uriinist eemal hoida.
